review_comments_data.body: @lilitkarapetyan - this will work for Heroku, and for a dev machine.  But, when Serge is running on a LAN, we can't hard-code `localhost`.

+export const socketPath = 'http://localhost:4000'

review_comments_data.body: @lilitkarapetyan - we can drop the `IBM_xxx` variables, can't we?

issues.title: Heroku instance not working

comments.body: @lilitkarapetyan - hmm, things seemed to work ok in the PR branch, but now `serge-review` can't connect to a database.  I've asked it to re-deploy, just in case that fixes it.
All working now, after Heroku magically restored their GitHub integration.
